facts.statement: Xinghaiornis was first named by Xuri Wang, Luis M. Chiappe, Fangfang Teng, and Qiang Ji in 2013.

facts.statement: Fossils of Xinghaiornis are known from the Early Cretaceous Yixian Formation in western Liaoning Province, northeastern China.
facts.quote: known from the Early Cretaceous Yixian Formation (Aptian stage) of western Liaoning Province, northeastern China

facts.statement: Xinghaiornis is classified within the unranked order Ornithothoraces.
Xinghaiornis lived between 125.77 and 119.57 million years ago, during the Barremian to Aptian stages.
facts.quote: Time range: Barremian to Aptian (125.77 to 119.57 million years ago)
